# Check Calendar Events

**Provider:** [Google Workspace](../index)

Lists events from a Google Calendar with optional time bounds, text query,
attendee expansion, ordering, and single-event expansion for recurring events.

## Command Path

google-workspace, check-calendar-events

## Categories

calendar, scheduling

## Aliases

list calendar, check schedule, upcoming events

## Provider Parameters

bearer_token, gmail_base_url, calendar_base_url

## Input Parameters

calendar_id, max_results, query, show_deleted, single_events, time_max, time_min

## Output Fields

events, next_page_token, time_zone

## Input Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  calendar_id:
    type: string
    description: Calendar identifier. Use "primary" for the authenticated user's primary calendar.
  time_min:
    type: string
    description: Lower bound RFC3339 datetime for event end time.
  time_max:
    type: string
    description: Upper bound RFC3339 datetime for event start time.
  query:
    type: string
    description: Free-text search terms for events.
  max_results:
    type: integer
    description: Maximum events to return, capped at 50.
  single_events:
    type: boolean
    description: Expand recurring events into individual instances.
  show_deleted:
    type: boolean
    description: Include deleted events.
```

## Output Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  events:
    type: array
    description: Matching calendar event summaries.
    items:
      type: object
  next_page_token:
    type: string
    description: Token for the next Calendar result page when available.
  time_zone:
    type: string
    description: Calendar timezone returned by Google Calendar.
```
